title: RunResult
description: Final result of a completed workflow run

stepResult.description: Result of a single workflow step

stepId.description: Identifier of the step that produced this result

output.description: Output produced by the step, or null if the step failed or was skipped

error.description: Error message if the step failed, otherwise null

durationMs.description: Time taken to execute the step in milliseconds

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow that was run

runId.description: Unique identifier for this run instance

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the run started

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the run completed

steps.description: Results for each step in the workflow

finalOutput.description: Final output of the last successful step, or null
